style: Original 4:3 photorealistic food, pale oak, beige linen, warm side light, exact same white square casserole and stainless steamer; no text, logos, people, hands or collage
first: Vegetable preparation with clean raw ingredients and empty white square dish
stages: In a separate matte ivory mixing bowl, raw ground pork mixed evenly with finely shredded white cabbage, sliced scallions, grated ginger and garlic, soy sauce and a small amount of sesame oil. A mixing spoon rests in the bowl. The white square casserole remains empty beside it. Raw mixture, not browned meat.

The empty white square 20 cm casserole dish sits on a metal steaming rack inside a very wide deep stainless steel pot, about 32 cm in diameter. A little water below the rack, clearly not touching the casserole. The pot is on an electric stovetop, lid set aside. This is checking the steaming setup before assembly, no food in casserole yet. Correct scale and fit.

Assembly stage: the white square casserole on the counter has one thin layer of square wonton wrappers across its base, minimal overlap, lightly moistened, and half of the raw pale pink pork and cabbage filling spread thinly over the wrappers. More square wrappers and remaining filling in separate bowl beside the dish. No cheese, no tomato sauce.

The white square casserole now assembled with THREE layers of thin wonton wrappers and TWO thin layers of raw ground pork and cabbage in between. Top is flat, slightly overlapping wet wonton squares, with a small amount of water around the edges. The layered build is visible at one front corner. No folded dumplings, no cheese, no red sauce.

Cooking stage: the same white square casserole of dumpling lasagna on a steaming rack inside the very wide stainless steel pot on the electric stovetop. Plenty of water below the raised rack, not touching the casserole. Glass pot lid in place, a little condensation and steam, the softened wonton top visible through it. No lettering or thermometer display.

After cooking, the white square casserole rests on a heatproof trivet. Soft translucent pale wonton top, fully cooked pork and cabbage layers, a small amount of savory juices around edges. A slim instant-read thermometer probe inserted into the center to check doneness, display turned away with no visible digits or words. No raw pink meat, no brown baked cheese crust.

Finished hero photograph of steamed pork dumpling lasagna in the same white square casserole. A generous square portion lifted on a serving spoon to show delicate translucent wonton layers alternating with fully cooked minced pork, cabbage and scallion filling. Tender glossy surface, small amount of clear savory juices, garnish of fresh sliced scallion and white sesame seeds. An ivory plate with a serving beside the casserole. No visible hands, no baked crust, no cheese, no tomato sauce, no folded dumplings. Elegant appetizing cover composition.
cover_correction: Final serving corrected to three wonton sheets and two meat layers, as specified in the recipe
